jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Who Youll Work With AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Aristas cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network - using protocols like 802.1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI - and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time. The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function - not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product. You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform. What Youll Do Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features - authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding - primarily in Go. Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e.g., RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves. Build and extend internal test utility libraries - simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers - and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test. Drive root-cause analysis on test failures - distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it. Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented - shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end. Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers. Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue. Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the teams test framework. Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews - identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them. Qualifications Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field. 3-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering - not just manual testing. Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred. Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis. Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols - 802.1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong. Hands-on experience with REST API testing - designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code. Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) - writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability. Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication - test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up. Good to have: Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS). Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) - knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior. Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios. Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) - validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: About us We're a small, fast-growing digital marketing agency, and we're betting big on AI to run a leaner, smarter business. We want to automate the repetitive work across support, sales and customer success so our team can focus on strategy, creativity and clients. You'll be the person who makes that happen. The role We're hiring a full-time AI Automation Expert to design, build and maintain AI-powered systems across the agency. You'll work hands-on with Claude Code and Grok (xAI) to turn manual workflows into reliable automations, connect them to our tools (Go High Level & Monday.com), and keep improving them as we grow. This is a builder role with real ownership. You'll scope problems with team leads, ship working solutions quickly, and document them so the team can use them every day. What you'll build Your first projects will cover three areas of the business, with plenty more to follow. AI support ticketing system: an intake, triage and routing system that categorizes client requests, drafts responses and escalates to the right person. Sales lead sourcing bot: a bot that finds and qualifies prospects that match our ideal client profile, enriches their data and pushes them into our pipeline. Customer success call intelligence: automations that capture client call data (summaries, action items, sentiment, upsell signals) and organize it in Monday.com. Whatever comes next: reporting, campaign workflows, internal tools and any process where AI can save time or improve quality. Responsibilities Audit our workflows across support, sales and customer success, and identify the highest-impact automation opportunities. Design, build, test and deploy AI automations using Claude Code, Grok and related APIs. Integrate AI systems with our tools, especially Monday.com, & Go High Level plus email, call recording, calendar and lead data platforms. Build prompts, agents and workflows that are reliable, monitored and easy to update. Write clear documentation and train team members to use what you build. Track results (time saved, response times, leads generated) and iterate based on feedback. Handle client and company data securely and responsibly. Stay current on new AI tools and recommend the ones worth adopting. Requirements Proven hands-on experience building with Claude Code and the Grok (xAI) API. Please show us real projects. 2+ years building automations, integrations or software, ideally for business operations. Strong skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience integrating with CRMs or work management platforms. Monday.com & GHL experience is a big plus. Solid prompt engineering and experience building AI agents or multi-step workflows. Able to take a loosely defined business problem and turn it into a working, documented solution. Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable explaining technical work to non-technical teammates. Available to work 9am-5pm Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. Nice to have Experience at or with a digital marketing agency. Familiarity with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier or n8n. Experience with call recording and transcription tools (e.g., Fathom) or speech-to-text APIs. Lead enrichment and scraping tools (e.g., Apollo, Clay) and an understanding of data privacy rules. Experience with helpdesk platforms or building ticketing systems. Compensation, hours and location Pay: $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month, based on experience Hours: Full-time, 9am-5pm Eastern Time (EST/EDT), MondayFriday Location: Remote Hiring process Our process ends with a paid, real-world project so you can show what you can build, and we can see how you work. Application review: we review your application and portfolio of AI automation work. Intro call (30 min): a conversation about your background, tools and how you approach automation problems. Technical interview ( 30 min): a walkthrough of a past project you built with Claude Code or Grok. Paid final project (top 3 candidates): you'll build a working AI support ticketing system prototype for our agency. You'll be paid for your time, and we'll provide a brief, success criteria and a deadline. Final review and offer: you'll present your project, and we'll choose the best fit for the team. 0-6 Yrs Automation engineering, Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Workflow, Python, Workflow Automation, Integration, Zapier
